subtype_label: Focus internal / focus inference (no given focus)
query: Help me understand what's worth analyzing in these incident tickets.

judge.implied_focus: Incident resolution performance / severity-and-speed profile of tickets

per_column.name: Is_Critical
per_column.rationale: Flags severity, a core facet of characterizing how urgent/important an incident is and a plausible driver of resolution performance.

per_column.name: Resolution_Speed
per_column.rationale: Directly measures how quickly incidents are resolved; this is the strongest anchor for a resolution-performance focus.

per_column.name: Is_Printer_Related
per_column.rationale: A narrow topical/category flag that sits somewhat apart from a severity/speed focus; it points more toward a 'what kind of issue' theme, weakening single-focus coherence.

judge.rationale: Two of the three columns (Is_Critical, Resolution_Speed) cohere around an incident-resolution-performance focus, pairing severity with speed in a reasonable predictor/outcome structure. However, Is_Printer_Related introduces a category-specific theme that is not clearly part of that focus, making the set read partly as a grab-bag rather than a tightly centred concept. The implied focus (resolution speed by severity) is genuinely actionable for an analyst, but the mixed signal and derived-flag granularity (binary criticality, one arbitrary category flag) keep coherence and structure at moderate levels rather than strong.
